item.description:
# Cove 1.4.0
- Combines the black sports and chat workspace with the latest updates from main. - Nori, the black companion with glowing eyes, has springier expressions and motion. List avatars stay still and Reduce Motion is respected. - Adds keyboard shortcuts, optional clipboard history, Bluetooth battery display, GitHub Actions activity, Claude token usage, and Claude cloud pull-request activity. - Keeps full sports Gamecast, favorites, offline logos, screenshot editing and persistent shelf undo. - Keeps existing local Codex chat prompts, exact chat targeting, retained drafts and accurate approval/input attention alerts. - New-release notices open Settings → About for signed in-app updates instead of asking you to download another copy.
Existing chat messaging supports local Codex chats. Claude cloud activity appears when a cloud session opens a GitHub pull request; it is a status view, not a cloud chat composer. Optional clipboard, CI and Bluetooth features can be enabled in Settings.
